text:
claire_m: Quick sync 1: we need social assets for next week's launch webinar: X thread (3 posts), LinkedIn carousel, short clip, and a PM template for inbound leads. Who can own which piece?

tony_l: I can do the 20s clip + thumbnail. Need final headline and three carousel CTAs by Wed EOD.

ben_o: I'll draft 2 benchmark lines for A/B test and wire the lead routing to the qualifier form. Suggest registrants -> qualifier -> score >=8 -> SDR queue; else nurture.

jess_p: I'll handle LinkedIn carousel copy + comment replies for 48h. Can batch replies hourly.

sam-bot: Proposed schedule: "Thu 16:00 UTC: X post 1", "Thu 16:10 UTC: X post 2 (stat + CTA)", "Thu 16:25 UTC: X post 3 (reminder)", "Thu 16:35 UTC: LinkedIn carousel". Confirm?

claire_m: Times good. Ben, use short.redwood.ai/qualify on post 2. Also add UTMs.

ben_o: Done. Stat A: "p95 latency down 45% for Gen workloads". Stat B: "unit cost per token down 30%". We'll put A in X post 2 and B in carousel.

tony_l: For exports: 1200x1200 carousel, 16:9 clip, transparent PNG thumbnail. I'll add presets in Figma.

jess_p: Reply script: "Thanks! Want the numbers? Fill a quick qualifier -> short.redwood.ai/qualify or reply 'demo' for a walkthrough." I'll pin that.

claire_m: Final checklist: assets (tony), stats + runbook UTMs (ben), carousel copy + replies (jess). Flag if anything slips.

ben_o: I'll also add a $300 boost on the stat post. Target CPL <$60.

claire_m: Perfect. Post 1 copy check? Who can drop one-liner for tone approval?

ben_o: "See how we make LLM inference predictable 141 and cost-effective. Join our 45-min webinar."

claire_m: Replace '41' with '—'. Looks good otherwise. I'll load drafts tomorrow.
